title: Inference-Layer Security: Defending Against Adversarial Inference and Infrastructure Abuse
abstract: arXiv:2609.38239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A Technical Report: Operating a large language model (LLM) as a service requires more than inference infrastructure: the provider must also defend against adversarial interactions that seek to exploit the service, including jailbreaking for harmful use, sophisticated denial of service, and distillation attacks. We study this problem at the inference layer, using a hypothetical frontier lab, Five Elements Inc., as a running example. Because no public labelled dataset of adversarial LLM usage exists, we introduce a structural causal model (SCM) that generates a realistically grounded, labelled dataset of user-sessions, with coordinated multi-account campaigns, platform feedback, and three tiers of label observability. On this dataset we train a practical gradient-boosted detector that classifies each user-session as benign or malicious and, if malicious, by attack type. Against oracle labels the detector very nearly solves the binary tas

translated_title: 推理层安全：防御对抗性推理与基础设施滥用
translated_abstract: 技术报告：将大语言模型（LLM）作为服务来运营，所需的不只是推理基础设施：服务提供商还必须防御试图利用该服务的对抗性交互，包括用于有害用途的越狱攻击、复杂的拒绝服务攻击以及模型蒸馏攻击。我们在推理层研究这一问题，并以一个假想的前沿实验室——五元素公司作为贯穿全文的运行示例。由于目前不存在公开的对抗性 LLM 使用标注数据集，我们引入了一个结构因果模型（SCM），用以生成贴近现实、带标注的用户会话数据集，其中包含协同的多账号攻击活动、平台反馈以及三个层级的标签可观测性。在该数据集上，我们训练了一个实用的梯度提升检测器，将每个用户会话分类为良性或恶意，若为恶意则进一步按攻击类型进行分类。相对于 oracle 标签，该检测器几乎完美地解决了二分类任务……
tldr: 该论文提出一种推理层安全方案，利用结构因果模型生成贴近现实的带标注对抗性用户会话数据集，并训练梯度提升检测器来识别与分类针对 LLM 服务的越狱、拒绝服务和蒸馏等恶意攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an inference-layer security approach that uses a structural causal model to generate realistically grounded labeled datasets of adversarial user sessions and trains a gradient-boosted detector to identify and classify malicious LLM-service abuse such as jailbreaking, denial-of-service, and distillation attacks.
